recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future review of this area should consider both the temporary reversal in FHIR-20351 and the later re-addition/rename in FHIR-29801 before changing DocumentReference.context targets.
issue_request: FHIR-15658 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Structured Documents request to add EpisodeOfCare as an allowed reference target for DocumentReference.context.encounter to align DocumentReference with event context.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by the 2018 DocumentReference/Composition block-vote commit 60707816, which explicitly included GF#15658 among the applied DocumentReference changes. A later Published/Persuasive issue, FHIR-20351, removed EpisodeOfCare from the then-current encounter element in 2019.
additional_context: The current build uses DocumentReference.context rather than the older context.encounter/encounter shape. FHIR-29801, a later Published/Persuasive with Modification OO decision, explicitly directed adding Appointment and EpisodeOfCare to the renamed context element, and commit d41daf2563b8d8afcba4dfbd11b877607215cd74 implemented that change. DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, so the current StructureDefinition source is in build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml already lists Appointment, Encounter, and EpisodeOfCare as DocumentReference.context target profiles.
